def fix_value(x):
    if x >= MOD:
        x -= MOD
    if x < 0:
        x += MOD
    return x

class Mat:
    def __init__(self, n=0, fill=0):
        self.size = n
        self.v = [[(fill if i == j else 0) for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    def __getitem__(self, i):
        return self.v[i]
    def __mul__(self, b):
        res = Mat(self.size, 0)
        for i in range(self.size):
            for j in range(self.size):
                for k in range(self.size):
                    res[i][k] = fix_value(res[i][k] + (self.v[i][j] * b[j][k]) % MOD)
        return res
    def __add__(self, b):
        res = Mat(self.size, 0)
        for i in range(self.size):
            for j in range(self.size):
                res[i][j] = self.v[i][j] + b[i][j]
        return res
    def __eq__(self, b):
        if self.size != b.size:
            return False
        for i in range(self.size):
            for j in range(self.size):
                if self.v[i][j] != b[i][j]:
                    return False
        return True

    result = Mat(base.size, 1)

    return result
